title_or_table: Congress.gov API, law endpoint, count of measures that became public law and private law, by Congress
observation_period: 93rd Congress (1973 to 1974) to 118th Congress (2023 to 2024), complete; 119th Congress (2025 to 2026) to November 11, 2026
universe_or_base: Bills and joint resolutions that became law, counted by Congress.gov's law endpoint; public laws apply generally, private laws to named people or entities
vintage: Congress.gov data as served on November 11, 2026
qualification: A count of laws says nothing about their length or reach: one appropriations law can run to over a thousand pages, and many laws name a post office. The 119th Congress is still in session, so its count is partial; Congress.gov counts can differ by a few from the Office of the Federal Register's list

years.description: the two calendar years the Congress spans

complete.description: false while the Congress is still in session

printed_source_line: Source: Library of Congress, Congress.gov, laws by Congress, 93rd to 118th Congress (1973 to 2024), United States. Retrieved November 11, 2026. A count of laws, short or long; the 119th Congress is still in session.

source_line_variants.last_ten: Source: Library of Congress, Congress.gov, laws by Congress, 109th to 118th Congress (2005 to 2024), United States. Retrieved November 11, 2026. A count of laws, short or long; the 119th Congress is still in session.
